summary.headline: Celemics: Largest shareholder Park Jong-gap pledges shares for KRW 3.5bn loan refinancing with Eltron
summary.what_happened: Largest shareholder Park Jong-gap pledged 487,425 shares of Celemics as collateral for a KRW 3.5bn loan taken by G&M, where he acts as pledgor and joint guarantor. The filing was corrected on Nov 26, 2026 because G&M refinanced its existing borrowing, changing the secured creditor from Blue C Investment Fund to Eltron Co., Ltd. under a contract dated Oct 13, 2026, with a pledge period from Oct 14, 2026 to Dec 15, 2026.

key_numbers.label: Stake if all pledged shares are foreclosed

summary.why_it_matters: Share pledges by major shareholders are generally disclosed so investors can see whether a controlling holder's stock could be sold to satisfy a debt if loan terms are breached, which could change ownership levels. Such filings typically reflect financing arrangements of the shareholder and do not by themselves indicate the company's operating performance.
